mutations.description: Leave caller-provided history in place instead of starting from a zero-input filter state.
Pair the current input with the wrong delayed sample.
Apply the outer coefficient to the second symmetric sample pair.
Understate the number of MAC operations required by the optimized step.
Publish filter state and output even when the cost transaction fails to commit.
Drop half-away-from-zero rounding for negative Q1.15 accumulators.
Cast positive overshoot instead of saturating it to int16_t.
Keep delayed samples in their old slots instead of advancing the FIR history.
Clear history but fail to publish an initialized filter state.
Run a step against caller state that has not been initialized.
Pass a NULL opaque cost handle into the cost boundary instead of rejecting it without calls.
Modify initialized filter history while rejecting a NULL cost model.
Modify initialized filter history while rejecting a NULL output pointer.
Issue MAC calls after the cost model rejects the transaction budget.
Pair x[n-1] with x[n-4] instead of x[n-5].
Pair x[n-2] with x[n-3] instead of x[n-4].
Use x[n-4] for the unpaired center tap instead of x[n-3].
Narrow the outer symmetric pair to int16_t before the MAC accessor.
Narrow the first inner symmetric pair to int16_t before the MAC accessor.
Narrow the second inner symmetric pair to int16_t before the MAC accessor.
Apply the center coefficient to the second inner symmetric pair.
Apply the first inner coefficient to the outer symmetric pair.
Apply the adjacent coefficient to the center sample.
Issue the correct outer and first-inner MAC operations in the wrong observable order.
Compute one tap directly and under-declare the instrumented work as three MACs.
Drop half-away-from-zero rounding for positive Q1.15 accumulators.
Cast negative overshoot instead of saturating it to int16_t.
Attempt a second cost commit after the first transaction commits.
Publish output before commit but restore it when commit reports failure.
Advance history before commit but restore it when commit reports failure.
Advance history in ascending order and overwrite older samples before copying them.
Store the filtered output as newest history instead of the raw input sample.
Commit state without publishing the computed output to the caller.
